[{"id":"9WqxsLmq3F","type":"header","data":{"text":"How to Send a Tolling Batch","col":12}},{"id":"bQuTinBkd7","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Phase 1: Outbound (TSBC Side)
This phase handles the sale and physical removal of biomass from your primary inventory.
1. Sales Order: Initiate a Sales Order from TSBC to Motley.
2. Sales Invoice: From the Sales Order, click Create > Sales Invoice to document the transaction.
3. Delivery Note: From the Sales Invoice, click Create > Delivery Note to ship the material out of TSBC.","col":12}},{"id":"bdR00h76eF","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Sales Order","col":3}},{"id":"H6PseGvidq","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Sales Invoice","col":3}},{"id":"E1UrINoy41","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Delivery Note","col":3}},{"id":"6rRyXDloON","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Phase 2: Inbound (Motley Side)
This phase automates the purchase and intake of the material into the partner entity.
4. Inter-company PO: Return to the original Sales Order and click Create > Inter-company Purchase Order.
- This will automatically generate the corresponding PO for Motley.
5. Purchase Receipt: Open the new Purchase Order and click Create > Purchase Receipt.
- Note: Ensure the target warehouse is set to Hemet - MT.
6. Purchase Invoice: From the Purchase Receipt, click Create > Purchase Invoice to finalize the inbound financial record.

This phase moves the material from your holding warehouse to the actual Tolling Partner.

- Entry Type: Select Material Transfer.
